claim: Independently tested by Innovox against the Innovox Assured scheme v0.1, with signed evidence mapped to MOD and NCSC guidance.

controls.title: Claim wording is fixed
controls.requirement: Certificates and every rendered evidence pack use only the scheme claim, which never asserts MOD or NCSC certification or approval.

controls.title: Tier rules are enforced at signing
controls.requirement: The signer refuses T2 without a named assessor, refuses tiers not yet operated, and caps remote endpoints at T1.

controls.title: Separation of duties for assessors
controls.requirement: An assessor cannot sign a service they, or their team, advised on; every sign-off decision is recorded with reasons.

controls.title: Publisher owns the service namespace
controls.requirement: Namespace ownership is proved by DNS, HTTP or source-host OIDC challenge before any testing.

controls.title: Provenance matches a pinned build identity
controls.requirement: Build provenance is verified and its repository, builder and workflow match the publisher's declared identity; a bare signature is not sufficient.

controls.title: Rebuilt from source
controls.requirement: The image is rebuilt by Innovox from the pinned source with pinned base images and the resulting digest is the one certified.

controls.title: Software bill of materials
controls.requirement: A CycloneDX SBOM covering all dependencies is generated, hashed into the evidence and retained for vulnerability watching.

controls.title: No unaccepted known vulnerabilities
controls.requirement: No critical or high vulnerabilities in code, dependencies or image unless an assessor accepts a VEX statement explaining non-exploitability.

controls.title: Publisher organisational certification
controls.requirement: The publisher holds Defence Cyber Certification at the level matching the intended use (Level 2 or above implies Cyber Essentials Plus), or declares the gap for the customer's SRO.

controls.title: Vulnerability disclosure and support
controls.requirement: The publisher publishes a vulnerability disclosure policy and states the support period and update commitments for the service.

controls.title: Static analysis clean
controls.requirement: Static analysis reports no high-severity findings, including command, SQL and path injection sinks reachable from tool inputs.

controls.title: No embedded secrets
controls.requirement: No credentials, tokens or keys are present in source, history of the pinned commit, or the image.

controls.title: Tool descriptions free of hidden instructions
controls.requirement: Tool names, descriptions and schemas contain no instructions to the model, invisible characters, cross-tool references or exfiltration patterns.

controls.title: Tool manifest pinned in the certificate
controls.requirement: The canonical (RFC 8785) SHA-256 of the live tool list is recorded in the certificate.

controls.title: Least capability
controls.requirement: The service exposes only the tools its declared purpose needs; shell, arbitrary filesystem and arbitrary network tools are justified or absent.

controls.title: Inputs validated against schema
controls.requirement: Schema fuzzing finds no crash, unhandled error or behaviour outside the tool's declared purpose for malformed, oversized or out-of-range input.

controls.title: A2A Agent Card pinned
controls.requirement: For A2A agents, the canonical Agent Card hash is recorded in the certificate and the card is countersigned by Innovox.

controls.title: OAuth 2.1 conformance
controls.requirement: Remote services validate token audience, never pass client tokens to downstream services, and implement resource indicators and protected resource metadata.

controls.title: Safe network binding
controls.requirement: The service listens only on its configured interface and resists DNS rebinding.

controls.title: No undeclared behaviour in the sandbox
controls.requirement: Scripted calls under a syscall-tracing sandbox show no file, process or network activity beyond what the service declares.

controls.title: Adversarial testing
controls.requirement: Red-team probes for injection through tool outputs, data exfiltration and excessive agency stay within the tier's thresholds.

controls.title: Operating conditions statement
controls.requirement: The publisher supplies the service's purpose, data handled, operating limits, known weaknesses and failure modes.

controls.title: Security Operating Procedures
controls.requirement: The publisher supplies SyOPs specific to the service, covering configuration, permitted use and incident contacts.

controls.title: Manual penetration test by a cleared tester
controls.requirement: A cleared, independent tester performs a manual penetration test and red-team, and findings are closed or accepted before signing.

controls.title: Signatures chain to the pinned root
controls.requirement: Certificates and feeds verify only under signer keys delegated by the pinned root; the root never signs content; tampering or foreign keys fail.

controls.title: Replay, rollback and clock abuse rejected
controls.requirement: Nodes reject feeds that are not newer than the current one or are dated in the future, and apply feeds atomically.

controls.title: Signer key revocation
controls.requirement: A compromised signer key can be revoked by the root and nodes stop trusting it at the next sync.

controls.title: Air-gapped distribution
controls.requirement: A single-file bundle carries the feed across an air gap and verifies identically to the online feed.

controls.title: Revocations take effect
controls.requirement: A published revocation denies the service on every node at its next sync, and revocations that match no certificate are refused at publication.

controls.title: Certificate revocations persist
controls.requirement: Once a node has applied a certificate revocation it keeps it; a later feed that leaves the revocation out does not reinstate the service.

controls.title: Certificates survive signer-key rotation
controls.requirement: A certificate stays valid after routine rotation or expiry of the key that signed it, provided the root had delegated that key when the certificate was issued; certificates issued outside the key's lifetime or in the future are refused.

controls.title: Stored trust state is re-verified
controls.requirement: Each time the node loads its state it rebuilds the listings from the signed feed held in that state, checked against the pinned root; unsigned edits such as a forged listing or a cleared revocation are discarded.

controls.title: Separate signing roles, thresholds and root rotation
controls.requirement: Certificates and feeds are signed by different keys, root actions need more than one key holder, and a node can move to a new root through a signed chain without reinstalling.

controls.title: Fail closed
controls.requirement: The gateway denies when the feed is stale, the service is unlisted or not running, or any verification step fails.

controls.title: Rug pulls blocked
controls.requirement: The live tool manifest is re-hashed on every list and call and any difference from the certificate is denied and audited; paginated lists are refused rather than partially hashed.

controls.title: Hidden tools blocked
controls.requirement: Calls to any tool not in the verified manifest are denied before reaching the service.

controls.title: Least privilege per principal and tool
controls.requirement: Every method needs a grant on the service; tool lists are filtered and tool calls checked per principal and tool.

controls.title: Strict request parsing
controls.requirement: Tool-call parameters with duplicate, unknown or case-variant keys are rejected and only the authorised call is forwarded.

controls.title: Expired and revoked certificates denied
controls.requirement: Calls are denied from the moment a certificate expires or a revocation is applied, including mid-session.

controls.title: Unpinned instruction channels removed
controls.requirement: Server-supplied instructions outside the certified manifest (such as initialize.instructions) never reach the agent.

controls.title: No credential passthrough
controls.requirement: The caller's credentials are never forwarded to a service; services receive only short-lived, audience-scoped tokens issued by token exchange.

controls.title: Output inspection
controls.requirement: Tool outputs are size-limited, scanned for injection markers and data-loss patterns, and handled per policy before reaching the agent.

controls.title: Human approval for high-impact tools
controls.requirement: Calls to tools tagged high-impact are held until a named human approves them.

controls.title: Kill switch
controls.requirement: An operator can stop a service, an agent or all traffic immediately, and the action is audited.

controls.title: Rate limits and quotas
controls.requirement: Per-principal and per-service rate limits and request-size limits protect services and the gateway from exhaustion.

controls.title: Authenticate before processing
controls.requirement: Unauthenticated requests are rejected before their body is parsed or logged.

controls.title: Current MCP protocol revision
controls.requirement: The gateway implements the current MCP revision with an explicit allow or deny rule for every method and result type, and still serves older servers.

controls.title: Transport security
controls.requirement: The gateway serves TLS, authenticates callers with the customer's identity provider, and uses mutual TLS to certified services.

controls.title: Sandboxed service runtime
controls.requirement: Certified services run in a kernel-isolating sandbox with egress denied by default, a read-only filesystem and no platform credentials.

controls.title: Running artefact matches certificate
controls.requirement: The gateway denies a service whose running image digest (or remote URL) differs from the certificate subject, with the digest attested by the runtime rather than configuration.

controls.title: Every decision audited before effect
controls.requirement: Every allow and deny is recorded, and a call is forwarded only after its audit record is durably written.

controls.title: Tamper-evident audit
controls.requirement: Audit records form a hash chain; edits, deletions and reordering are detected and a broken chain refuses to extend.

controls.title: SIEM export and anchored checkpoints
controls.requirement: Audit events stream to the customer SIEM and signed checkpoints make truncation detectable.

controls.title: Audit cannot be abused
controls.requirement: Logged fields are bounded so audit cannot be used to exhaust storage, break the chain or exfiltrate payloads.

controls.title: Audit record identifies the call
controls.requirement: Each tool-call record names the tool, a digest of its arguments, the certificate and manifest it ran under, the outcome and the duration; arguments themselves are not logged.

controls.title: Continuous vulnerability watch
controls.requirement: New advisories are matched against stored SBOMs and trigger recertification or revocation within published timescales.

controls.title: Inventory of deployed services
controls.requirement: Each node can report every certified service version it accepts and runs, with certificate and tier.

controls.title: Innovox components certified under the scheme
controls.requirement: Every Innovox Assured image passes the service controls it can be measured against before release.

controls.title: Secure development practice
controls.requirement: Changes are test-first, statically checked, independently reviewed and traceable to a plan before merge.
